QuestInfo.name: An Information Dealer's Work
QuestInfo.0: You should start training in Victoria Island and ask #bthe Information Dealer of #m104000000##k, named #b#p1002104##k, for some help.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1002104# says being an Information Dealer is the best way to experience the world. #p1002104# then gives you a simple quest to understand the type of work an Information Dealer does... Go to #b#p1002001##k, investigate the rumors that have been circulating among the crewman, and report to #p1002104#.

#y21707# #b(#u21707#)#k
QuestInfo.2: You relayed to #p1002104# all the rumors you heard from #p1002001#. You guess this is the type of thing that informants do all the time.

0.0: If you want to gain life experience through training, you've come to the right place. Becoming an informant would be perfect for that! What's an #binformant#k, you ask? It's simple really.
0.1: The role of the Information Dealer is to gather up information collected from various regions and sell it to people willing to pay a price for that information. The role of the informant is to gather that information for the Information Dealer. Wait, I think it'd be better for you to just go out and try it.

yes.0: Have you seen a person named #b#p1002001##k in #m104000000#? He's a pretty famous crewman. Find out from him what rumors are spreading amongst the crew.

no.0: Hmmm...so I don't think you understand the role just yet. I'll explain it to you again, so talk to me when you're ready.

1.0: Did you manage to squeeze some valuable information out of #p1002001#? Spill the details for me.\n#b#L0#(You tell him what you learned from #p1002001#...)#l\n#k
1.1: Okay, that's pretty good. Wasn't that simple? #bGathering up information like this, that's the role of an informant#k, okay?

yes.0: I seriously think you have a talent for being an informant. Continue to work like this, and you'll gain some valuable experience on gathering valuable information. Shall we move on to the next task?

quest.0: Haven't you gone to see #b#p1002001##k yet? Your job is to gather up the latest information that's circulating among the crewmembers by talking to #p1002001#. If #p1002001# #basks for something in return, then you'll have to give him whatever he wants in exchange for the information#k. It's just gathering up rumors, so he won't ask you to do much.
